record.name: Ecwid
record.one_liner: Ecwid REST and JS APIs provide programmatic access to store data, orders, products, and checkout customizations using OAuth 2.0 and API keys.

auth.notes: Ecwid uses OAuth 2.0 authorization simplified for single-store customizations as well as API keys (client_id, client_secret) and access tokens.

access.notes: Users can access the API by visiting the app dashboard in the Ecwid admin to create custom applications and get access tokens.

api_surface.notes: The public API surface includes a REST API, webhooks for real-time notifications, and JavaScript (JS) API calls for storefront/cart management.

mcp.notes: There is no mention of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) in the documentation.

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve credentials can be generated directly via the Ecwid admin app dashboard, and the REST API and webhooks are thoroughly documented.

evidence.claim: Ecwid REST API allows access to store data and uses OAuth 2.0 authorization.
Ecwid webhooks send automatic real-time notifications via POST requests.
Custom apps for accessing the API can be created via the app dashboard in the Ecwid admin.
